# Options Reference

```
fedcat [--version] <subcommand> [options]
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`discover`](#discover) | Run GWAS discovery and federated conditioning. |
| [`convert-annots`](#convert-annots) | Convert annotation TSV files to optimised parquet schema. |
| [`meta`](#meta) | Run IVW fixed-effects meta-analysis. |
| [`acat`](#acat) | Compute ACAT p-values. |
| [`subset-results`](#subset-results) | Subset meta-analysis results for conditioning (step 0). |
| [`summarise-indep`](#summarise-indep) | Regenerate conditioning summaries for a finished run. |
| [`collinearity`](#collinearity) | Check collinearity of candidate variants against a selected set. |
| [`setup-workflows`](#setup-workflows) | Stage repo WDL workflows + dependencies into the workspace. |
| [`cromwell`](#cromwell) | Set up, start, check or stop a Cromwell server for local_cromwell. |

### `discover`

```
fedcat discover [options]
```

Run GWAS discovery and federated conditioning. Conditioning parameters (p-value threshold, r² threshold etc.) live in the config JSON.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | str |  | **(required)** Path to the config JSON (DiscoveryConfig schema). |
| `--variant-density-blockfile` | str | `variant_density_blocks.tsv` | Path to the variant density block file: whitespace-separated 3-column file CHROM START END (header optional). |
| `--run-blockfile` | str |  | Optional whitespace-separated 3-column file CHROM START END (header optional). If set, restricts step2 to within these blocks only (inclusive). |
| `--start-phase` | str | `latest` | Phase to start at (default: start or resume progress along --phases-to-run). Choices: `step1`, `step2_singles`, `step2_aggregates`, `meta_analysis`, `step0_subset`, `conditioning_singles`, `conditioning_aggregates`, `latest`. |
| `--phases-to-run` | str[] | `step1, step2_singles, step2_aggregates, meta_analysis, step0_subset, conditioning_singles, conditioning_aggregates` | Ordered space-separated list of phases to run (default: all phases). Choices: `step1`, `step2_singles`, `step2_aggregates`, `meta_analysis`, `step0_subset`, `conditioning_singles`, `conditioning_aggregates`. |
| `--one-phase` | flag |  | Only run a single phase then exit. |
| `--covar-stratum` | str[] |  | With stratify_by_covar set in the config, restrict this invocation to the named covariate strata, 'combined' for the unsplit run (default: every covariate stratum the config asks for, run in parallel). |
| `--meta-mode` | str | `auto` | Specify the meta-analysis mode (default: auto). auto picks from --phases-to-run: singles_only if only singles phases (step2/conditioning) are listed, aggregates_only if only aggregates phases are, otherwise all. Choices: `auto`, `all`, `singles_only`, `cond_singles_only`, `uncond_singles_only`, `aggregates_only`. |
| `--overwrite-config` | flag |  | Overwrite persisted config values with those from the input --config. |
| `--reset-jobs` | int |  | State value to reset failed jobs to (default: previous state). In conditioning phases, acts as the conditioning JobState reset value. |
| `--force-reset` | flag |  | Force current phase into ERROR then apply --reset-jobs. In conditioning phases, forces the conditioning step into ERROR. |
| `--reset-jobs-list` | str[] |  | Space-separated list of exact job descriptions to reset. |
| `--force-job-retry` | flag |  | Resubmit failed jobs, with inputs rebuilt from the current config (in conditioning, a step that failed outside its jobs reruns the stage it failed in). Running and completed jobs are left alone, and if nothing failed the run just resumes. |
| `--list-jobs` | flag |  | List current jobs (descriptions and states) then exit. |
| `--abort-all` | flag |  | Abort every running cloud job recorded in this run's state (all phases and conditioning steps), after confirmation, then exit. Stop any fedcat process driving the run first. State files are unchanged: on resume the aborted jobs are recorded as failed, so rerun them with --force-job-retry. |
| `--report` | flag |  | Report job states, task counts and costs for every phase and conditioning step of this run, then exit. Costs come from the platform where it reports them (DNAnexus) or from Cromwell's task metadata, which covers failed and preempted attempts too; where neither is reachable they are estimated from the logs of successful tasks. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  | Build jobs, serialise a state snapshot and print a summary, then exit without submitting. |
| `--skip-validation` | flag |  | Skip the checks that workflows and remote input files (pheno, cov, pfile, step1 input, annotations) exist. |
| `--logging-level` | str | `INFO` | Logging verbosity (NOFILE → TRACE to stdout only, no log files). Choices: `NOFILE`, `TRACE`, `DEBUG`, `INFO`. |
| `--delay-start` | str[] |  | Defer job launch until a flexible time, given as a relative delay or an absolute time: 'in 2 hours', '90m', '1h30m', 'tomorrow 9am', '14:30', '2026-07-22 09:00' (see dateparser documentation). |

**Conditioning options**

_Runtime controls for the conditioning phases. Threshold parameters (p-value, r², collinearity checking) belong in the config JSON (cond_p_agg_retest, cond_p_singles_retest, cond_rsq_threshold, cond_check_coll, cond_max_steps)._

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cond-step` | int |  | Start conditioning at this step number (default: 0 / autodetect from disk). |
| `--cond-reset-step` | int |  | Reset a failed conditioning step to this StepState integer value. |
| `--cond-one-step` | flag |  | Run only a single conditioning step then exit. |
| `--cond-singles-tarball` | str |  | Path to a pre-built singles subset results tarball to start step-0 singles conditioning from, instead of the one built by the step0_subset phase. Supported only for a single-phenotype run. |
| `--cond-agg-tarball` | str |  | Path to a pre-built aggregate subset results tarball to start step-0 aggregate conditioning from, instead of the one built by the step0_subset phase. Supported only for a single-phenotype run. |

### `convert-annots`

```
fedcat convert-annots [options]
```

Convert annotation TSV files to the optimised parquet schema used by the ACAT engine.  Run this once per annotation set and pass --schema-dir to downstream ACAT/conditioning steps.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--masks` | str[] |  | **(required)** One or more REGENIE masks definition TSV files (MASK&lt;tab&gt;annot1,annot2,...). |
| `--annots` | str[] |  | **(required)** One or more REGENIE annotation TSV files (VARIANT&lt;tab&gt;UNIT&lt;tab&gt;ANNOT). |
| `--output-dir` | str |  | **(required)** Directory to write the parquet schema files into (created if absent). |

### `meta`

```
fedcat meta [options]
```

Run IVW fixed-effects meta-analysis on per-cohort REGENIE output files.  Input files are defined via a cohort file (see --cohort-file).

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cohort-file` | str |  | **(required)** Text file defining per-cohort input files. Lines starting with '# &lt;name&gt;' define cohort names; subsequent non-empty lines are file paths for that cohort. |
| `--output-file` | str |  | **(required)** Output file path for meta-analysis results. |
| `--res-type` | str |  | **(required)** Result type (e.g. 'single_variants', 'burden', 'mac10'). |
| `--compression` | str |  | Output compression codec. If omitted, inferred from output file extension. Choices: `zst`, `gz`. |
| `--compression-level` | int |  | Compression level (codec-specific). |
| `--backend` | str | `streaming` | Meta-analysis backend (default: streaming). Choices: `streaming`, `merge`. |
| `--aaf-bins` | str |  | Comma-separated allele-frequency bins. Each cohort contributes to bin F only where its own A1FREQ &lt;= F; output has one row per variant and bin (AAF_BIN column). For the single-variant input to ACAT. |
| `--chrom-col` | str |  | Column name for CHROM. |
| `--genpos-col` | str |  | Column name for GENPOS. |
| `--id-col` | str |  | Column name for ID. |
| `--allele0-col` | str |  | Column name for ALLELE0. |
| `--allele1-col` | str |  | Column name for ALLELE1. |
| `--a1freq-col` | str |  | Column name for A1FREQ. |
| `--n-col` | str |  | Column name for N. |
| `--beta-col` | str |  | Column name for BETA. |
| `--se-col` | str |  | Column name for SE. |
| `--log10p-col` | str |  | Column name for LOG10P. |
| `--test-col` | str |  | Column name for TEST. |
| `--col-separator` | str |  | Field separator character for input files. |

### `acat`

```
fedcat acat [options]
```

Compute ACAT p-values from single-variant and optional burden meta-analysis outputs.  Requires either --schema-dir (parquet) or --masks-tsvs + --annotations-tsvs.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--single-variants-file` | str |  | **(required)** TSV file with single-variant summary stats. |
| `--burden-file` | str |  | Optional TSV file with burden summary stats. |
| `--output-file` | str |  | **(required)** Output file path for ACAT results. |
| `--schema-dir` | str |  | Directory containing pre-converted parquet schema (mutually exclusive with --masks-tsvs/--annotations-tsvs). |
| `--masks-tsvs` | str[] |  | One or more REGENIE masks definition TSV files. |
| `--annotations-tsvs` | str[] |  | One or more REGENIE annotation TSV files. |
| `--aggregate-freqs` | str | `0.001` | Comma-separated upper allele-frequency bounds for aggregate tests, used verbatim as threshold/ID labels (default: '0.001'). One set of ACAT aggregates is produced per threshold. |
| `--id-col` | str | `ID` | ID column name (default: ID). |
| `--allele-freq-col` | str | `A1FREQ` | Allele frequency column name (default: A1FREQ). |
| `--log10p-col` | str | `LOG10P` | -log10(P) column name (default: LOG10P). |
| `--n-threads` | int |  | Number of threads (default: cpu_count - 1). |
| `--weighting-scheme` | str | `standard` | Variant weighting scheme (default: standard). Choices: `standard`, `equal`. |
| `--compression` | str |  | Output compression codec. If omitted, inferred from output file extension. Choices: `zst`, `gz`. |
| `--compression-level` | int |  | Compression level (codec-specific). |
| `--backend` | str | `sweep` | ACAT backend (default: sweep). Choices: `sweep`, `arrow`. |
| `--no-full-bounds` | flag |  | With TSV annotations, take mask START/END only from variants with single-variant results (faster; burden-only masks get NA). Default: bounds from all annotated variants. |

### `subset-results`

```
fedcat subset-results [options]
```

Subset meta-analysis results for conditioning (step 0). Scans burden, ACAT, and singles outputs for significant hits and packages tarballs for downstream conditioning.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--phenotypes` | str[] |  | **(required)** Phenotype names to process. |
| `--chr` | str |  | Optional chromosome label for tarball naming (e.g. 1, 22, X). |
| `--acat-file` | str |  | ACAT output TSV. If provided, ACAT hits are included in the aggregate tarball. |
| `--burden-file` | str |  | Burden meta-analysis TSV. If provided, burden hits are included in the aggregate tarball. |
| `--singles-file` | str |  | Unconditional singles meta-analysis TSV. If provided, singles subset tarball is created. |
| `--annotations` | str[] | `[]` | Annotation TSV files (required for --acat-file/--burden-file unless --schema-dir is given). |
| `--masks-tsvs` | str[] | `[]` | REGENIE masks TSV files (used with --annotations; ignored when --schema-dir is set). |
| `--schema-dir` | str |  | Parquet schema directory (alternative to --annotations). |
| `--log10p-threshold` | float | `6.0` | Minimum -log10(P) to include in tophits (default: 6.0 = P&lt;1e-6). |
| `--agg-p-threshold` | float |  | P-value threshold for ACAT/burden tophits, i.e. cond_p_agg_retest (overrides --log10p-threshold). |
| `--singles-p-threshold` | float |  | P-value threshold for singles tophits, i.e. cond_p_singles_retest (overrides --log10p-threshold). |

### `summarise-indep`

```
fedcat summarise-indep [options]
```

Regenerate conditioning summaries (all_sig / all_top_sig / trace files) for a finished or old run, from its per-step summary_output tables and a JSON containing top-level 'passing_ids'.  Back-compatible with old fedcat/fedcond/looper versions; no cloud upload or state persistence is performed.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--run-dir` | str |  | **(required)** Conditioning run directory containing the {cond}_cond_step{N} subdirectories. |
| `--cond-type` | str |  | **(required)** Conditioning type: 'singles' (single-variant) or 'agg' (aggregate). Choices: `singles`, `agg`. |
| `--pheno` | str |  | **(required)** Phenotype name (used in the output filenames). |
| `--passing-ids-json` | str |  | Override path to the JSON containing top-level 'passing_ids'. Auto-located within --run-dir when omitted. |
| `--end-step` | int |  | Override the highest conditioning step to include. Auto-detected from the step directories when omitted. |
| `--output-dir` | str |  | Override the results output directory (default: {run-dir}/{cond}_cond_results). |
| `--stat-col` | str |  | Test-statistic column base name. Auto-detected from the summary_output header when omitted (older runs use 'P' instead of 'LOG10P'). Choices: `LOG10P`, `P`. |

### `collinearity`

```
fedcat collinearity [options]
```

Check collinearity between selected (conditioned-on) and candidate variants from a plink2 pgen/pvar. Reports per-candidate VIF R² against the selected set and the max VIF R² across the augmented set.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-p`, `--pfile` | str |  | **(required)** plink2 pgen/pvar prefix. |
| `-s`, `--selected` | str |  | **(required)** File of selected (conditioned-on) variant IDs. |
| `-c`, `--candidate` | str |  | **(required)** File of candidate variant IDs. |
| `-o`, `--out` | str |  | **(required)** Output TSV path. |
| `-t`, `--threads` | int |  | **(required)** BLAS thread count. |
| `-b`, `--batch-size` | int | `1000` | Candidate variants processed per batch (default: 1000). |
| `--rsq-threshold` | float | `0.99` | Pairwise r² above which a candidate is flagged degenerate (default: 0.99). |

### `setup-workflows`

```
fedcat setup-workflows [options]
```

Stage a biobank's WDL workflows and their runtime dependency scripts into the current Workbench workspace. Uploads dependencies to the workspace bucket, bakes the per-workspace dependencies_path into each WDL, and registers them via 'wb workflow create'. Only 'aou' is currently implemented.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--biobank` | str | `aou` | Biobank workflow set to stage (default: aou). Only 'aou' is implemented. Choices: `aou`, `ukb`. |
| `--bucket` | str |  | Workspace bucket (gs://… or bare name) for uploads. If omitted, you'll choose from the workspace's CONTROLLED buckets (via wb). |
| `--bucket-id` | str |  | Workbench bucket resource id for 'wb workflow create'. Defaults to the resolved bucket's resource id (or --bucket when given explicitly). |
| `--version` | str | `1.7.1` | Dependency-bundle version for the bucket layout (default: 1.7.1). Workflows are registered as &lt;wdl&gt;-v&lt;version&gt; (e.g. -v1-7-0). Must match the cohort's dependencies_version in the run config. |
| `--repo-root` | str |  | Path to the biobank_workflows checkout holding the WDLs / dependency scripts. Auto-detected from the fedcat package and cwd when omitted. |
| `--force` | flag |  | Replace existing workflows without prompting. |
| `--skip-existing` | flag |  | Leave existing workflows untouched. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  | Log actions without executing. |

### `cromwell`

```
fedcat cromwell [options]
```

Manage a Cromwell server for the local_cromwell backend: write its config (Google Batch, rooted in a workspace bucket), start it in the background, check its health, or stop it.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | str |  | **(required)** setup: write cromwell.conf via 'wb cromwell generate-config' plus fedcat's settings; start: launch the server in the background and wait until healthy; status: check the server is healthy and on a cloud backend; stop: shut it down. Choices: `setup`, `start`, `status`, `stop`. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | Path | `~/cromwell` | Directory for cromwell.conf, its log, pid file and database (default: ~/cromwell). |
| `--port` | int | `8000` | Server port (default: 8000). fedcat discover reads CROMWELL_URL when it is not the default. |
| `--bucket-id` | str |  | setup: Workbench bucket resource id to root workflow execution in. If omitted, you'll choose from the workspace's CONTROLLED buckets (via wb). |
| `--concurrent-job-limit` | int | `2000` | setup: most tasks Cromwell runs at once (default: 2000). Keep within the project's Batch quota. |
| `--force` | flag |  | setup: overwrite an existing cromwell.conf. |
| `--memory` | str | `16g` | start: JVM heap for the server (default: 16g); raise for phases with many thousands of tasks. |
| `--cromwell` | str | `cromwell` | start: the cromwell command, or a path to cromwell.jar (default: cromwell). |
| `--timeout` | float | `300` | start/stop: seconds to wait for the server to come up or shut down (default: 300). |

## State codes

Integer state codes used by `--reset-jobs` and `--cond-reset-step`:

```python
class JobState(IntEnum):
    ERROR = -1
    EMPTY = 0
    READY = 1
    RUNNING = 2
    COMPLETED = 3


class StepState(IntEnum):
    ERROR = -1
    READY = 0
    SORT_INPUT = 1
    GENERATE_JOBS = 2
    RUN_JOBS = 3
    DOWNLOAD_RESULTS = 4
    CHECK_RESULTS = 5
    META_ANALYSE = 6
    COMPLETED = 7
```
